title: ui-confirm: create ProblemDisplay component
description: Create a reusable ProblemDisplay component that renders the problem statement and key context for the Progressive Discover confirm phase. This component displays the crystallized problem text in a visually prominent format that helps users quickly understand and validate the problem definition.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL display the problem statement in a readable format
THE SYSTEM SHALL preserve all formatting from the original problem text

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a problem is selected for confirmation
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL render the ProblemDisplay component with the current problem context

event_driven.trigger: WHEN the problem text is updated
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL refresh the ProblemDisplay to show the updated content

unwanted.condition: IF the problem text is empty or null
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT render an empty component
unwanted.because: displaying empty content confuses users and breaks the visual layout

unwanted.condition: IF the problem exceeds display limits
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT truncate without indication
unwanted.because: users need to know when content is abbreviated

preconditions: Problem context must be available in the application state
The component must receive a valid problem ID or object reference
postconditions: The problem statement is rendered with all original formatting preserved
invariants: Problem text content is never modified by this component
Display formatting remains consistent across renders

happy: Given a valid problem object, when rendered, then displays the problem title and description
Given a problem with formatted text, when rendered, then preserves markdown formatting
Given a long problem statement, when rendered, then displays with appropriate overflow handling
error: Given a null problem reference, when rendered, then displays an appropriate placeholder or error state
Given an empty problem text, when rendered, then shows a helpful message indicating no content
Given an invalid problem ID, when rendered, then gracefully handles the error without crashing

phase_2: Create ProblemDisplay component with problem prop

similar: See FieldCard component for display patterns
